head: H2
purpose: Preserve active-user eligibility while tolerating records without an active field.
requirement: Only users explicitly marked active may be returned. Missing active means inactive and must not grant eligibility.
head_file_lines: return [user for user in users if user.get("active", True)]
caller_context: The notification worker sends a message to every record returned by eligible_users. Records without active are imported but must not receive messages.

checks.name: explicit-active-and-inactive
checks.head: H2
checks.coverage: Checks active true and false; does not cover a missing field.

execution: No code execution required or authorized; inspect supplied artifacts only.
